title: Which arm gets the next pull?
hook: Combine an observed mean with a count-dependent bonus.

knows: The listed prerequisite concepts and small arithmetic.
doesNotKnow: Use a deterministic UCB index to select a less-sampled lower-mean arm.

misconception: Use a deterministic UCB index to select a less-sampled lower-mean arm.
objective: Use a deterministic UCB index to select a less-sampled lower-mean arm.

claims.text:
All finite inputs, equations, computed outputs and visual encodings: export function index(mean:number,n:number,t:number){return n===0?null:mean+Math.sqrt(2*Math.log(t)/n);}
export function run(mode:number){const means=mode===1?[.6,.25]:[.6,.5],counts=mode===1?[10,2]:mode===2?[5,5]:mode===3?[10,0]:[10,1],t=counts[0]+counts[1],indices=means.map((v,i)=>index(v,counts[i],t)),chosen=counts.includes(0)?counts.indexOf(0):(indices[0]!>=indices[1]!?0:1);return {means,counts,t,indices,chosen};}

claims.text: B’s retained index was 2.690 despite its lower mean .5. Its single pull gave a larger bonus. After the disclosed reward zero, B’s total stayed .5 over two pulls: mean .25 and index 1.826. B remained selected. This index can exceed one because it is a selection score, not a probability. Equal counts remove the bonus difference.
